prayer: PRAYER: Criminal Original Petition is filed under Section 528 of BNSS Act, to direct the learned Special Court for SC and ST (POA) Act cases, Ramanathapuram to accept the surrender of the petitioner and to consider his bail application on the same day on merits in connection with FIR in Crime No. 57 of 2026 dated 29-3-2026, on the file of the second respondent Abiramam Police Station, Ramanathapuram District.
judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

R. Vijayakumar, J.:— The present petition has been filed by the sole accused in Crime No. 57 of 2026, on the file of the second respondent police seeking a direction as against the trial court to consider the bail application of the petitioner on the same day of surrender.

2. Considering the averments in the petition, there shall be a direction to the Special Court for SC and ST (POA) Act cases, Ramanathapuram, to consider the bail application of the petitioner on the same day of surrender in Crime No. 57 of 2026, after giving due opportunity to the defacto complainant.

3. The petitioner shall surrender before the concerned Court on or before 22-6-2026.

4. With the above said observations, this Criminal Original Petition stands allowed.
